title: Red After Midnight
logline: A homebound teenager finds Manchester United through dusk kickoffs and ruthless counter-attacks — and learns that loyalty outlasts winning.
audience: Football kids who watched at home as day turned to dark, diaspora friends, and anyone who fell for a club before they understood form tables.
intent: By the end, the viewer should feel that support can become identity — kept even when the glory years fade.
